meta.title: Wan-Jian Yin · CMSG
meta.description: Wan-Jian Yin, Professor at Soochow University: talent programs, education, professional experience, research interests, and scholarly activities.

items.title: Selected as a Distinguished Professor under the Changjiang Scholars Program of the Ministry of Education
Selected for the National High-Level Overseas Young Talents Program
Ph.D. in Physics, Department of Physics, Fudan University
B.S. in Physics, Department of Physics, Fudan University
Postdoctoral Researcher
items.note: Research mentors: Su-Huai Wei and Yanfa Yan

sections.title: Research Interests
items: Crystal structure prediction and full-space inverse materials design
Materials formation and synthesis: understanding and predicting how materials form in nature and how target phases can be synthesized through physics-based computation and artificial intelligence
Microscopic mechanisms of transport in nanoconfined materials and methods for their control and optimization

sections.title: Research and Teaching Activities
items: Serves as a reviewer for leading international journals in physics, chemistry, and materials science, including Nature Materials, Physical Review Letters, Physical Review B, Journal of the American Chemical Society, The Journal of Physical Chemistry, Nature Communications, Advanced Materials, and Energy & Environmental Science.

From 2012 to 2013, taught modules on the electronic structure of solids and first-principles calculations in undergraduate and graduate courses—including Condensed Matter Physics and Physics of Solar Energy Materials—at the Department of Physics and Astronomy, University of Toledo.
At Soochow University, teaches the undergraduate courses Energy Physics and Semiconductor Physics.

sections.title: Publications
sections.text: Professor Yin has authored or co-authored more than 160 publications, which have received over 19,000 citations.
